extra.question: List all the mythic rarity print cards banned in gladiator format.
extra.evidence: mythic rarity printing refers to rarity = 'mythic'; card banned refers to status = 'Banned'; in gladiator format refers to format = 'gladiator';
extra.question_with_evidence: List all the mythic rarity print cards banned in gladiator format. Hint: mythic rarity printing refers to rarity = 'mythic'; card banned refers to status = 'Banned'; in gladiator format refers to format = 'gladiator';
extra.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.id FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.format = 'gladiator' AND T2.status = 'Banned' AND T1.rarity = 'mythic'
